name: Unstaked Ai Monitoring Opens Review
text: Cao proposes evaluation frameworks that agents can use for self-correction. Kaal's position is that unstaked monitoring does not solve the verification problem, because AI that monitors AI inherits the flaws of the agents it oversees. A red status is therefore not a verdict. It opens a review, with the evidence attached, by reviewers who have something at stake.
scope_conditions: Cao's paper is a position paper citing benchmark evidence, not an empirical test of these claims.
The position is Kaal's own argument in the essay Prompts Don't Govern Agents. Reputation Does.
The position does not validate Cao's figures, benchmark methodology, or reported benchmark results.
The position is limited to AI evaluation, red-status review, and reviewer incentives.
